policy: One image is not expected to boot on every device. Each target must have a compatible boot chain, kernel, device tree, firmware, and tested image.

targets.name: Orange Pi Zero 3
targets.notes: Current source build target. The existing release artifact is specific to Allwinner H618. Physical boot and peripheral validation remain required.

targets.name: Raspberry Pi family
targets.notes: Separate model-specific images and firmware are required. Do not use the Orange Pi image.

targets.name: Intel/AMD 64-bit PCs
targets.notes: Requires a PC-specific image pipeline, UEFI boot support, storage and graphics testing.

targets.name: Virtual machines
targets.notes: Separate artifacts such as qcow2, raw virtual disks, or ISO must be built and tested for each guest architecture and hypervisor.

targets.name: Other ARM64 single-board computers
targets.notes: Each board needs its own supported bootloader, kernel, device tree, firmware, and hardware validation.

targets.name: Android phones and tablets
targets.notes: Not a standard Linux PC/SBC target. Requires per-model bootloader unlock support, device trees, kernel/vendor drivers, partition and recovery compatibility. No generic Android image is promised.
